purpose: User-requested causal depth-feature history for sustained rough/flat policy switching; frozen v5/v10, no retraining.

history_semantics.step_rounding: ceil(seconds/dt - 1e-9), support/confirmation in sampled control intervals
history_semantics.denominator: Recorded samples only, capped to the applicable window. Recorded unknowns count in denominator; unfilled slots do not.
history_semantics.unknown: Hold target; invalid samples never mean flat. Clear consecutive evidence; after15 unknown samples expire prior history. Existing fade can finish.
history_semantics.reset: Only episode-done environments lose state; portal wraps do not reset history.
history_semantics.unchanged: Spatial thresholds/ROI/coverage and dwell.5s/fade.15s match v11. Temporal windows and confirmations differ.

integrity_rules: New sources pinned after CPU and GPU smoke, before holdout
Exact initial root/joint/observation hashes across all4controllers for each map/scenario
Stop on mismatch, preserve evidence, no automatic retry or tolerance relaxation
All first episodes retained; no post-reset rewards/successes
No tuning or second candidate after holdout outcomes
improvement_vs_instant: Lower terrain switches per100 first-episode active seconds
Primary flat fall rate no higher
limits: One frozen policy training seed42, two maps: diagnostic, not universal best-policy claim
Memory+confirmation mechanism, not proof of isolated memory causal benefit
Depth-feature history is not a trained RNN/LSTM policy or world map
